Sustainability Management The ENN Energy Board of Directors has established an ESG Committee mandated to formulate ESG strategies, set targets, monitor performance, and report progress regularly to the Board. The group is responsible for coordinating and facilitating dedicated ESG efforts, and reports regularly to the ESG Committee on governance outcomes. Research on topics Through methods such as questionnaires and interviews, we gathered feedback and suggestions from internal and external stakeholders on the Company's ESG management. A survey was conducted covering stakeholders including directors and senior management, employees, government and regulatory bodies, shareholders and Environmental Social Governance investors, customers, suppliers and partners, community members, experts, and industry associations, yielding 246 valid responses. Topic prioritization Based on the survey results, topics were prioritized along two dimensions—"importance to ENN Energy" and "importance to ENN Energy's stakeholders"—resulting in the ENN Energy Materiality Matrix.
